answer: Incident: one model fingerprint backed 41 accounts in a single epoch. The crystal is that sampled fingerprint; a second identity from the same one is refused inside the epoch. Cap graded submissions per fingerprint, then drop the overflow before review. Standing also bleeds while an identity idles, so a meadow of parked accounts decays instead of saving up. A farm must run distinct models and keep each warm, compute it cannot resell, which is the anchor the whole scheme rests on.
